description: This file defines utility functions, classes, and types for agent tools, including parameter parsing, error handling, image processing, and tag validation within an agent framework.

classes.name: ToolInputError
classes.description: Custom error class for input validation errors in tools.

classes.name: ToolAuthorizationError
classes.description: Specialized error class for authorization failures, extending ToolInputError.

methods.name: createActionGate
methods.description: Creates a function to determine if an action is permitted based on provided actions object.

methods.name: readStringParam
methods.description: Reads and validates a string parameter from input, with options for trimming, required, and allowing empty.

methods.name: readStringOrNumberParam
methods.description: Reads a parameter that can be a string or number, converting number to string if needed.

methods.name: readNumberParam
methods.description: Reads and validates a numeric parameter, with options for integer and strict parsing.

methods.name: readStringArrayParam
methods.description: Reads an array of strings from input, handling string or array input types.

methods.name: readReactionParams
methods.description: Parses reaction parameters including emoji and removal flag.

methods.name: stringifyToolPayload
methods.description: Converts a payload to a JSON string or fallback string.

methods.name: textResult
methods.description: Creates a tool result with text content.

methods.name: failedTextResult
methods.description: Creates a failed status tool result with text.

methods.name: payloadTextResult
methods.description: Creates a tool result with payload serialized as text.

methods.name: jsonResult
methods.description: Creates a tool result with JSON stringified payload.

methods.name: wrapOwnerOnlyToolExecution
methods.description: Wraps a tool to restrict execution to owners only.

methods.name: imageResult
methods.description: Generates an image result with optional sanitization.

methods.name: imageResultFromFile
methods.description: Reads an image file, detects MIME type, and returns an image result.

methods.name: parseAvailableTags
methods.description: Validates and parses available tags from raw input.
